name: Money
summary: Makes an amount and its currency one value with arithmetic of its own, so that a number whose meaning depends on a currency cannot be added to one that means something else.

roles.name: Money
roles.summary: The money value itself, holding an amount and the currency it is in, and refusing arithmetic that would mix two currencies. What it adds over a plain decimal is allocation: dividing a sum between several parties without losing or inventing a cent, which no rounding of a bare number does correctly.
